strategy_lines.label: Audience
strategy_lines.text: US health systems with 5 or more hospitals, on Epic. Roles: CIO, Chief Data Officer, VP Analytics.

strategy_lines.label: Offer
strategy_lines.text: The Epic Data Readiness Assessment, a 2-week review that scores the health system's Epic data for AI use. CTA: Request the assessment.

strategy_lines.label: Message
strategy_lines.text: Vantacor turns Epic Clarity data into an AI-ready model in 30 days, where a build takes health systems 9 months. Proof: Three health systems went live in under 30 days.

strategy_lines.label: Channel: LinkedIn ads
strategy_lines.text: LinkedIn ads (paid social), $30,000 at $150 a lead

strategy_lines.label: Tracking
strategy_lines.text: Salesforce campaign VANT-H1 on every lead, primary campaign source on the opportunity.

strategy_lines.label: Funnel
strategy_lines.text: Average deal $50,000, 5% of leads become opportunities in 70 days
